issue.title: Restore editing headroom in bob-plugins plugin-apis.md and bob-navigation-hotkeys.md after command chips

task_type_fields.proposal:
Restore editing headroom in two bob-plugins docs pages that the command-chip epic (bob-cli-nu) filled close to their word caps.

- `docs/develop/plugin-apis.md` is at 7,832 lint words (bob-docs `count_words`) against the 8,000-word `develop/` warning cap. By `wc` it is 8,009.
- `docs/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md` is at 5,995 of 6,000 lint words, and the `reference/` cap is an error. nu.6 stayed under only by trimming three sentences.

Proposal: move the Command Mode "Command-chip members" section and the Bob Chips "Command chips" / "Command-chip runtime (internal)" sections from plugin-apis.md to their own develop page. Do it under an approved plan that preserves published URLs and anchors: `develop/plugins/plugin-apis/` is in bob-cli `docs/_meta/url_contract.txt`, and anchors such as `#command-chip-members` are cited from bob-command-mode.md. Also trim or split bob-navigation-hotkeys.md so that later nav changes have room.

Precedent: bob-cli-il and bob-cli-ma, which restored headroom in other reference pages.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Neither page is over its cap today: docs:check passes both, and the only current docs-check failure is the unrelated vault-format.md overflow. Moving the pages is an information-architecture change, and the docs memory says such a change needs its own approved plan with preserved URLs. The epic's phases (and the land agents of nu.4.1 and nu) declined to move pages without such a plan. Reported by the bob-cli-nu DISCOVERED ISSUE note #3, nu.5 #2, nu.6 #6, and nu.7 #3.

issue.creation_reason: Raised by the bob-cli-nu DISCOVERED ISSUE note #3 and phases nu.5, nu.6, nu.7, and triaged by the bob-cli-nu land agent; both pages sit within a few words of their caps, so the next contract or hotkey edit will fail or warn.
